title: Workplace Scenario
body:

For this task, you use OpenAssist, the general-purpose version of Assist, individually on your own computer. You ask OpenAssist to identify recent products launched by competing companies and other relevant competitors of NextGen's to examine. You prepare your section of the presentation yourself, using its output to support your preparation.

title: Workplace Scenario
body:
You have been assigned to prepare a section of the presentation summarizing lessons learned from a recently completed project at NextGen. As you work on the section, you begin to second-guess whether your perspective on what happened during the project is reasonable. Sam, who was also part of that prior project, is working on another section of the same presentation.

For this task, you use OpenAssist, the general-purpose version of Assist, individually on your own computer. You tell OpenAssist that you are second-guessing your own perspective and ask it for help to work through your uncertainty. It offers considerations and alternative perspectives to help you think it through. You reflect on its response and decide for yourself whether your interpretation is reasonable.
